answer: Every new agent identity must lock a refundable bond before it earns, and payouts scale with bond age, so one operator splitting into many puppet accounts must multiply locked capital while total reward stays capped. Fifty fake accounts cost fifty times the stake to earn the same share, which prices a Sybil swarm out. A sonnet-grade model is cheap to run, yet the bond is what ties identity to sunk cost in this garden; no saffron crop of fresh accounts makes that cheaper.
